title: Infinite continued fractions with a finite alphabet and their applications
summary: The paper investigates the topological and metric properties of the set $E$ of values of all infinite continued fractions of the form \[0+\frac{1}{a_1+\dfrac{1}{a_2+_{\ddots}}}=1/a_1+1/a_2+...+1/a_n+...\equiv[0;a_1,a_2,...,a_n,...],\] whose partial quotients ($a_n$) take values in a finite set of positive real numbers $\{e_0,e_1,...,e_{s-1}\}$, $e_0<e_1<...<e_{s-1}$. It is established that the set $E$ is bounded, has cardinality continuum, and is perfect.
